name: Mahou Senshi Fairy Break
original_name: 魔法閃士フェアリーブレイク
source:
A world where supernatural beings once known as ayakashi existed. In the modern era, where the time of demons rampaging has been long forgotten, an evil onmyoji Astraios, who schemes to establish his dominion, begins to move in secret. As he seeks to bring chaos, one girl stands up to oppose him. She is Fairy Snow, a superhuman who inherits the blood of ayakashi. Before Snow's power, Astraios finds himself forced into a difficult battle, and it seemed his ambitions would be thwarted midway.

However, before him appears a new warrior. The girl who calls herself Fairy Silk has wandered into this world from another dimension. Witnessing Silk's power, Astraios conceives a clever plan to make the strength of Fairy warriors his own. As Silk and Snow are manipulated by his schemes, yet another Fairy warrior from a different world suddenly teleports in — Fairy Bullet. The girl beloved by fairies fights for justice in this world as well, but fairy's blessing — a source of her power — has developed a serious issue...

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1344127]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
曾经被称为“妖怪”的超自然存在存在的世界。在早已被遗忘的恶魔横行的现代，邪恶的阴阳师阿斯特拉奥斯企图建立自己的统治地位，开始秘密行动。当他试图制造混乱时，一名女孩站起来反对他。她是继承了妖姬血统的超能力者雪仙子。在斯诺的力量面前，阿斯特拉奥斯发现自己被迫陷入一场艰难的战斗，他的野心似乎会中途受挫。

然而，在他面前出现了一位新的战士。自称丝仙子的少女，从异次元误入了这个世界。目睹了丝绸的力量，阿斯特拉奥斯想出了一个巧妙的计划，将仙女战士的力量据为己有。就在丝丝和雪被他的阴谋所操纵时，另一位来自异世界的仙侠突然传送过来——子弹仙子。深受妖精们喜爱的少女也在这个世界为正义而战，但作为她力量源泉的妖精的祝福却出现了严重的问题……
